title: The Frozen Mountain
subtitle: A riddle made of winter
opening: Above the caves, snow hangs in the air like tiny stars. The Frost Queen waits beside a bridge of ice.
ending: The Frost Queen lowers her staff. A path of blue light reaches the Unicorn Forest. Its magic has gone quiet, but something bright is hiding inside a bubble.
not_yet: That place is resting. Follow the glowing landmark on your quest card.

steps.title: The queen at the ice bridge
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Welcome, Liza. I am Queen Orielle. Strong magic needs a gentle hand. Bring me three gifts of winter, and I will teach you how to cool a dragon’s fire.

steps.title: The gifts of winter
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Find a Snow Pearl at the Moon Crystal, a Frost Fern at the Elder Tree, and a Winter Chime at the Treasure Chest. Return to the queen when all three are yours.

steps.title: The Frostbind spell
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Snow Pearl, Frost Fern, Winter Chime: hold the heat and still its climb. This is Frostbind. It cools what burns without hurting what lives.

steps.title: The queen’s four-note riddle
steps.clue: Repeat my winter song: Moon Crystal, Treasure Chest, Elder Tree, Moon Crystal. Wave once at each, in that order. If you forget, we can sing it again.
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle

steps.title: The answer was kindness
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: You remembered. The last note came home to the first. Magic is strongest when you return what you borrow. Remember that when you meet Emberwing.

steps.title: Mend the frozen bridge
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Visit the Elder Tree. Use Glowmend to repair the bridge instead of breaking the ice. A family of snow mice is sleeping underneath.

steps.title: A mirror of the forest
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Go to the Treasure Chest. Truthlight can wake the queen’s mirror. Wave and look for the unicorns.

steps.title: The forest inside the mirror
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: The Unicorn Forest has been zapped! Black vines have tangled its paths. Willow, the Good Witch, is keeping the unicorns safe inside her great shining bubble.

steps.title: A lantern of winter light
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Take Frostbind to the Moon Crystal. Cool a little star into a lantern. Its blue light will guide you down the other side of the mountain.

steps.title: Follow the blue light
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: Your path is ready. Find Willow in the Unicorn Forest. She knows a way up Fire Mountain, but first she needs someone brave enough to help her friends.
